Text: A royal letter arrives: "The old town lies in ruins, but every town starts somewhere. Take this lumber and these plans, and build an Inn so adventurers have a place to rest." Buildings need their blueprint and some materials (and sometimes gold). Click Build on the Inn.

"Green Slimes are oozing all over the Plains road! Bring me back 5 Green Ooze and I'll know you can handle yourself." Green Slimes drop Green Ooze. Like gold, it's only yours once you get home (or if it's in your Save Sack).
Rewards: Blueprint Alchemist; Room Plains: Blue Slime Patch; Room Plains: Blue Slime Ambush

Text: "An old alchemist wants to set up shop. Build a workshop and the Alchemist will brew you a Health Flask from that Ooze." Flasks refill every time you Rest at a campfire. Blue Slimes now live in the Plains too.
Rewards: Blueprint Shop; Blueprint Guild Hall; Gold 10

Text: "Something BIG is growing in the Plains. I've marked its nest on your map." The Big Slime Nest is now in the Plains room deck for good. Beat it, rest at its campfire, and Tier 2 opens.
